primegodling.race.prime_godling.descript: A newborn deity awakens — a being born from the weave of primordial light and will unshaped by fate. The Prime Godling gazes upon a world of limitless possibility, its soul carrying the echo of creation itself.
primegodling.race.celestial_essence.desc: The godling's mortal shell begins to shed. What remains is purer than spirit — an essence woven from star-stuff and the first breath of the cosmos. The heavens themselves grow silent in recognition.
primegodling.race.ecliptic_warden.descri: Twilight bends to the Warden's will. Neither light nor dark may claim dominion where one who walks the ecliptic stands. The boundary between day and night becomes a threshold, not a barrier.
primegodling.race.luminarch_god.descript: Radiance given form. The Luminarch God burns with an inner sun that illuminates the unseen truths of the world. At this height, the veil between the mortal and the divine grows thin enough to step through.
primegodling.race.primordial_supreme_god: The journey ends where it began — at the source of all things. The Primordial Supreme God is no longer a being who wields power; it has become the hand that writes what power is. Existence bends, and does not break.
primegodling.skill.primordial_bloom.desc: Passively regenerates magicules. Periodically spawns blooming particles. Mastery: also grants Regeneration to nearby players.
primegodling.skill.cosmic_awareness.desc: Toggle: grants presence sense, detects invisible entities, and marks entities that target the bearer. Drains energy while active.
primegodling.skill.stellar_ascension.des: Toggle: boosts attack damage and maximum health with a celestial particle aura. Deals bonus magic damage on attack. Mastery: slow falling while falling.
primegodling.skill.ecliptic_mastery.desc: Passively grants bonus armor and toughness. Reflects damage back to attackers and has a chance to negate incoming damage. Mastery doubles the effect.
primegodling.skill.luminarch_blessing.de: Toggle: grants Regeneration, Absorption, and highlights all living entities within 24 blocks through walls (Glowing). Mastery: 48-block range and heals nearby allies.
Bestows overwhelming divine fortitude, boosting all core attributes. Grants Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, fall damage immunity, and 30-50% damage reduction. Greatly accelerates skill learning.
primegodling.skill.creation_authority.de: Ultimate Skill. Passively grants +6 Attack, +16 HP, +4 Armor, +4 Toughness. Press to call down primordial lightning that devastates the target area with a massive explosion. Grants brief damage immunity after activation. High energy cost.
primegodling.skill.divine_devour.descrip: Unique Skill. Press the skill key while looking at a mob to attempt to steal one of its skills. 10% chance per use. Cooldown: 10 ticks (3 when mastered).
awakening.primegodling.divine_nexus.name: Divine Nexus
awakening.primegodling.divine_nexus.desc: The third path alongside True Demon Lord and True Hero. Requires Luminarch God, 150k EP, and 5 unique skills.
item.primegodling.nexus_core.desc: A crystallised fragment of raw creation energy. Use to unlock the Divine Nexus awakening.
item.primegodling.nexus_core.tooltip: Luminarch God only. Bring to the Awakening Altar to open the Divine Nexus path.
advancements.primegodling.root.title: Prime Godling
advancements.primegodling.root.descripti: The path of the primordial gods begins
I Am All That Is Prime
Become a Prime Godling — a newborn deity with all resistances
advancements.primegodling.celestial_esse: Evolve to Celestial Essence — the second stage of godhood
advancements.primegodling.ecliptic_warde: Evolve to Ecliptic Warden — master of light and darkness
Evolve to Luminarch God — the gatekeeper of the Divine Nexus
advancements.primegodling.primordial_sup: Evolve to Primordial Supreme God — the apex of the Prime Godling line
advancements.primegodling.divine_nexus.d: Awaken the Divine Nexus — become one with the primordial source
advancements.primegodling.divine_nexus.r: You are now connected to the primordial source. Creation Authority granted.
